[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC bob-cli-mc[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Ctrl+W N — numbered tab hints and an in-place tab jump[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]In Bob's Obsidian, every main-area tab carries a quiet numeral [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim](1–9, in reading order across splits) beside its title, and Ctrl+W [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]followed by that digit focuses exactly that tab where it lives — [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]selected inside its own split, never moved, cloned, or reopened — [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]while the numerals brighten into accent key caps when the Ctrl+W [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]card appears and the destination numeral flashes once to confirm [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]the jump.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim] Counts: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]5[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] phases[dim][/dim] · [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]4[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] waves[/dim]

[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Tab catalog, digit planner, and main-area enumeration[/bold #D7AFFF]         [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]model[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]model: add the pure tab catalog, digit normalization, focus-tab planner,[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]numeral visibility verdict, and view-model tab data, plus read-only [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]main-area and hotkey readers that do not need a main-area active leaf.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]In-place tab-jump executor[/bold #D7AFFF]                                    [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]actions[dim] · [dim][/dim]after model[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]actions: execute focus-tab plans losslessly (load if deferred, session [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]check, setActiveLeaf, invariants, restore), fold the selectedTab fix [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]through the move executor, and prove it on real Obsidian with a new e2e [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]tabs group.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Tab numerals, card tabs row, and previews[/bold #D7AFFF]                     [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]paint[dim] · [dim][/dim]after model[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]paint: build the dormant tab-numeral stamper and CSS (idle, lit, here, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]flash, stacked) and the card's pill ranges and tabs row, with a [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]light/dark preview harness and unit tests.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Digits in the Ctrl+W prefix, palette commands, go live[/bold #D7AFFF]        [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]prefix[dim] · [dim][/dim]after actions, paint[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]prefix: wire digits into the Ctrl+W state machine with an armed-catalog [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]freeze, light the numerals with the card, flash on success, add Jump to [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]tab 1–9 commands, flip the dormant seams, bump the minor version, and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]prove it on real Obsidian.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  5 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Docs, visual acceptance, and polish[/bold #D7AFFF]                           [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
